title: Introduction to the COIP (Comprehensive Organic Criminal Code)
description: Learn the basic concepts of the COIP, crimes, misdemeanors, and citizens' rights.
content: The COIP regulates crimes, misdemeanors, and penalties in Ecuador. Examples: theft, threats, domestic violence, etc. Every citizen should know their criminal rights and duties.

title: Rights and Contracts in the Civil Code
description: Learn how to protect your property, contracts, and resolve boundary conflicts.
content: The Civil Code regulates property, contracts, leases, and boundaries. Example: how to make a lease contract, what to do in a boundary conflict, etc.

title: Labor Standards for the Countryside
description: Rights and obligations of agricultural employers and workers according to the Labor Code.
content: The Labor Code protects day laborers and employers. Topics: minimum wage, working hours, vacations, social security, etc.

title: Land and Territory Legality
description: Learn about the Land Law and how to validate the legality of your property.
content: The Organic Land Law regulates the ownership, use, and legality of rural properties. Important to avoid conflicts and access credits or state programs.
